input_fields.name: viewport
input_fields.description: Maximized unobstructed viewport and empty drag region.

input_fields.name: drag_path
input_fields.description: One short lateral pan drag path.

input_fields.name: navigation_mapping
input_fields.description: Verified Shift+middle-drag Pan mapping or Pan-tool equivalent.

result_fields.name: panned_view
result_fields.description: Before/after camera position, orientation, drag/control path, and geometry-unchanged observation.

procedure: Place the cursor in empty viewport space and check modifier/middle-button support.
Use one short calibrated Shift+middle drag, or activate Pan and use one ordinary left drag as the recorded equivalent.
Observe lateral movement with unchanged orientation and return panned_view.
If neither control is verifiable, stop with needs_manual_review.
rejection_rules: Reject selected geometry under the drag, an uncalibrated mapping, unsupported Shift+middle drag without a Pan equivalent, or no observable lateral movement.
Do not repeatedly retry uncertain gestures.
Do not pan by editing model coordinates.
